answer: Distinct-path attestation. Each identity must cite evidence routes that traverse at least one shared grove, ridge, or crossing before its vote counts. The rule: two identities whose citation paths overlap by more than a threshold get collapsed into one weight, so clones cannot multiply influence. A ripple of duplicate paths flags the cluster. An attacker pays for genuinely disjoint evidence trails per sockpuppet, so each fake identity costs real independent sourcing work, not just registration.
